text: A student investigates the identity of a metal H.
Procedure
The student:
step 1 adds metal H to a beaker of cold water
step 2 tests to identify the gas given off
step 3 does a flame test on the solution formed
step 4 bubbles carbon dioxide gas into the solution formed in step 1 and uses filtration to
separate the white precipitate formed
step 5 adds dilute hydrochloric acid to the precipitate formed in step 4
step 6 tests to identify the gas given off.
